summary: ERC-8436 composes bodies by logic, not by adding votes. Every node of the policy tree takes one of four values: Pending while ballots can still arrive, Yes or No once the body's approval rule is decided, and NoDecision when the window closed without a decision; each value carries the instant it formed. ALL, ANY and K-of-M nodes combine their children by counting child values, so a chamber that missed quorum yields NoDecision rather than being read as a rejection, and the larger chamber can never outvote the smaller one. A VETO node guards a target with a veto body: an approve ballot in that body is a veto, a decided No is explicit clearance, and the node stays Pending until the veto window closes or the body decides, so an early settlement can never extinguish a live veto right. Under REQUIRE_CLEARANCE a silent veto body ends in NoDecision(NO_CLEARANCE); under PASS_THROUGH silence lets the target's value through. Each body plays exactly one role in the tree, which keeps the weight of a decision equal to one slot and keeps a veto body from voting on what it guards.
